result:
Both modes work. The `--balance` mode:

1. Reads all events, filters to those with `sourceAccount`/`destinationAccount`/`quantity`
2. Accumulates debits on source accounts, credits on destination accounts
3. Groups output by account type (first path segment), ordered logically
4. Flags per-account imbalances (net != 0) — note these are expected since each individual account will have a net position; the *system* total (debits = credits) is the real balance check
5. Shows throughput by commodity
6. Supports `--commodity <name>` filtering

The "imbalanced accounts" section shows accounts with nonzero net positions — every account will appear there unless it happens to have equal debits and credits. The system-level check ("System balanced") is the true double-entry validation: total debits must equal total credits.
